brief.headline: Push for modest price cut to ₹0.65–0.80/pc on caps (market says possible at higher volume) and move payment to 15 days for ₹2.60 L cash freed up — then line up Manjushree as qualified second source

priceAsk.summary: Ask for a price cut to ₹0.65–0.80/pc on the 28 mm induction-wad PP cap
priceAsk.basis: Open-market asking price for this cap runs ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc, and the verdict says MARKET-FAIR with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec — so we want the lower band

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 30 days to 15 days after receipt
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: ₹2.60 L cash freed up for us

brief.financialLeverage: Bprex publishes no financials, so we don't know their revenue, profit, or how tight their cash is. Our ₹63.21 L annual spend may be small or big to them — we can't tell. That means we lean harder on our own purchase data, the open-market price bands, and on qualifying a strong second source (Manjushree, India's largest rigid-plastic converter) to create real choice. Without their numbers, the discipline comes from a credible Plan B and the fact that the market says a better price is possible.

evidence.point: We spend ₹63.21 L a year with Bprex
Current payment terms are 30 days after receipt
Paying 15 days earlier frees up ₹2.60 L cash for us
Open-market asking price for a 28 mm induction-wad PP cap is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc, verdict MARKET-FAIR with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec
evidence.figure: ₹0.55–1.20/pc typical ₹0.85–0.95/pc verdict MARKET-FAIR; modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80

evidence.point: HDPE resin import unit value (a raw-material benchmark) sits at 87.61 ₹/kg
Bprex is a private supplier and does not publish financials

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter — pharma bottles, caps, preforms; revenue ₹2569.83 Cr, health B (65/100) — the top second-source candidate

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader doing pails, containers, pharma packaging — strong, profitable, a robust alternate for bottles and closures

alternates.name: Hitech Corporation Ltd (a lead to qualify — verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Listed maker of moulded and blow-moulded packaging with broad capability across bottles and caps

risks: Bprex's finances aren't public, so we can't see if they're healthy or stretched — watch for any signs of delivery trouble or quality slip that might hint at stress
The market price verdict says modest headroom, not a big gap — so push for ₹0.65–0.80/pc but be ready to land at ₹0.75–0.85/pc if volumes or specs don't flex enough
None of the alternates (Manjushree, Mold-Tek, Hitech) are qualified yet — they're leads from research, not approved second sources, so we need to audit and price them before we have real leverage
Moving payment to 15 days saves us ₹2.60 L, but only if Bprex can handle the faster cycle without stumbling on deliveries — ask how they manage cash today
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We're looking to lock in a better price — the market says ₹0.65–0.80/pc is possible at our volume — and we'd like to move to 15-day payment, which frees up cash for both of us; let's talk about how we get there together.
